chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
The tree whose trunk is soft has thick branches.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the hadith 'The tree whose trunk is soft has thick branches'?
ai.summary: In this metaphor from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) illustrates that a leader or individual who remains humble and approachable ('soft trunk') attracts greater loyalty and virtue ('thick branches'). This reflects the Shia ethical principle that *tawadu* (humility) is not weakness but a source of spiritual and social abundance, contrasting with the rigidity of pride.
